compatibility_receipts.license_expression: CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
compatibility_receipts.license_expression_source: ~/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/blake3-1.8.5/Cargo.toml [package].license, independently verified by this lane 2026-10-31 (matches S3's dependency_licenses observation)
compatibility_receipts.permissive_classification_rationale: The expression is a disjunction with an Apache-2.0 arm; under license-token-containment (the R1 gate's own classifier) any arm landing in the gated MIT/Apache/MulanPSL class gates the edge. Apache-2.0 is a widely-deemed permissive license (OSI-approved, FSF free, GPL-compatible, no copyleft transmission on aggregation) — the same class the R1 gate already permits with a registered receipt. The CC0-1.0 arm alone would be sovereign-class (no attribution/notice requirement); the LLVM-exception arm is Apache-2.0 with an additional permission, strictly no more restrictive. Selecting the Apache-2.0 arm of the disjunction is lawful for a downstream consumer, so blake3 is consumable by P28-SIL on permissive terms.

notice_carriage_obligations.mechanism: Selecting the Apache-2.0 arm of the OR-expression carries Apache-2.0 §4 notice obligations: retain (a) the license text and (b) all copyright/patent/trademark attribution notices from the work's source.
required_files: ~/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/blake3-1.8.5/LICENSE_A2LLVM (Apache-2.0 with 'LLVM Exceptions to the Apache 2.0 License' addendum at line 204, verified present)
notice_carriage_obligations.cargo_notice: Cargo/vendored crates carry the LICENSE_A2/LICENSE_A2LLVM/LICENSE_CC0 files inside blake3-1.8.5/ automatically under standard vendoring; a shipped-binary redistribution must include the Apache-2.0 license text and blake3's copyright notices (LICENSE_A2 + LICENSE_A2LLVM; LICENSE_CC0 optional if the Apache arm is selected).
notice_carriage_obligations.open_note_for_operator: The CC0-1.0 arm of the disjunction imposes zero notice obligations; if the operator prefers, the receipt could instead cite CC0 selection, which would reclassify the edge sovereign-class — that is a legal-strategy decision above lane authority.
